info.name: Prafi API
info.description:
Backend API for Prafi (Express + Sequelize + PostgreSQL), with realtime notifications over Socket.IO.

## Setup (once)
1. Import this collection and `Prafi-Local.postman_environment.json`, then select **Prafi Local** (environment dropdown, top right).
2. In **Prafi Local** set `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (Current value) to the superadmin from `.env` (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD`), then Ctrl+S.
3. Start the server (`npm run dev` or `npm run build && npm start`). `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:4000`.

## Login and roles
- Every request uses **Bearer `{{token}}`** (set on the collection; requests inherit it). Public requests have *No Auth*.
- **Auth → Login** saves the token to `{{token}}` (valid **1 hour**). To switch role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the Login body) and send Login again.
- The **name of each request says who can call it**: `(All roles)` = superadmin, admin and tenant; `(superadmin, admin)`, `(admin)`, `(tenant)`… = only those roles; `(Public)` = no login. Any other role gets **403**.

| role | created by | starts | can |
|---|---|---|---|
| superadmin | seed (`npm run db:seed`) | active | register admins, activate admin/tenant accounts, read everything, manage tenant categories |
| admin | superadmin (*Register Admin*) | **inactive** until a superadmin activates it | activate tenant accounts **and products**, read users/products/tenants, manage tenant categories |
| tenant | public sign-up (*Register Tenant*) | active | manage their own products and tenant profile |

## Endpoints
| folder | endpoint | access |
|---|---|---|
| Health | `GET /api/health` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/login` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/logout` | All roles |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register/admin` | superadmin |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register/tenant` | Public |
| Auth | `GET /api/auth/me` | All roles |
| Auth | `PATCH /api/auth/me` | All roles |
| Images | `POST /api/images` | All roles |
| Images | `GET {{imagePath}}` | Public |
| Images | `DELETE /api/images/{{imageId}}` | tenant |
| Users | `GET /api/users` | superadmin, admin |
| Approvals | `PATCH /api/approvals/{{userId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Approvals | `PATCH /api/approvals/{{productId}}` | admin |
| Products | `GET /api/products` | All roles |
| Products | `GET /api/products/{{productId}}` | All roles |
| Products | `POST /api/products` | tenant |
| Products | `PATCH /api/products/{{productId}}` | tenant |
| Products | `DELETE /api/products/{{productId}}` | tenant |
| Landing | `GET /api/landing/products` | Public |
| Tenant Categories | `GET /api/tenant-categories` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `GET /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `POST /api/tenant-categories` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `PATCH /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `DELETE /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `POST /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `PATCH /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `DELETE /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants/{{tenantProfileId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Notifications | `GET /api/notifications` | All roles |
| Notifications | `GET /api/notifications/unread-count` | All roles |
| Notifications | `PATCH /api/notifications/{{notificationId}}/read` | All roles |
| Notifications | `PATCH /api/notifications/read-all` | All roles |
| Notifications | `DELETE /api/notifications/{{notificationId}}` | All roles |
| Examples | `GET /api/admin/ping` | superadmin, admin |
| Examples | `GET /api/tenant/ping` | All roles |
| Realtime (WebSocket) | Socket.IO at `{{baseUrl}}` | All roles (Bearer token) |

## Saved variables
Requests save what the next ones need: `token`, `currentUserId`, `currentRole` (Login) · `userId`, `userRole`, `registeredEmail` (Register) · `imageId`, `imagePath` (Upload Image) · `productId` · `categoryId` · `tenantProfileId` · `notificationId`. Each save is printed in the Postman Console.

## Example walkthrough
1. **Login** as superadmin → **Register Admin** → **Activate / Deactivate User** (activates the new admin) → **Create Tenant Category**.
2. **Register Tenant** → set `loginEmail` = `{{registeredEmail}}`, `loginPassword` = `{{newUserPassword}}` → **Login** (now tenant) → **Upload Image** → **Create My Tenant** → **Upload Image** again → **Create Product**.
3. **Login** as the admin (`admin…@prafi.test` / `{{newUserPassword}}`) → **List Notifications** → **Activate / Deactivate Product** → **Landing Products** shows it.

## Responses
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"?: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`
- `message` and `details[].message` are in **Bahasa Indonesia** (ready to show in the frontend). `code` and `field` stay in English; frontend logic should switch on `code`.

| status | code (examples) | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `BAD_REQUEST`, `ID_NOT_PROVIDED` | invalid input (`details` lists the fields) |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | no/invalid/expired/logged-out token → log in again |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN`, `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` | wrong role, or the account is not activated |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | not found, or not yours |
| 409 | `UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT`, `STILL_IN_USE`, `CONFLICT` | duplicate value, record still in use |
| 413 | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | image over 5 MB |

## Notifications and realtime
Every role gets notifications for the events that concern them (see **Notifications**); activation notifications include the `approval` with `userId` and the `user`. They arrive live over Socket.IO as `notification:new` (see **Realtime (WebSocket)** for connecting in Postman and in the frontend).

exec: var save = (key, value) => { pm.environment.set(key, value); console.log('saved {{' + key + '}} = ' + value); };
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON, e.g. an image */ }
if (body) pm.test('Response has a success flag', () => pm.expect(body).to.have.property('success'));
// Login: keep the token as {{token}} for every other request
// Explain auth failures in the Console
console.warn(pm.info.requestName + ' → ' + pm.response.code + ' ' + body.error.code + ': ' + body.error.message + (role ? ' (logged in as ' + role + ')' : ' (not logged in: send Auth → Login)'));

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Login, logout, registration and your own account (`/api/auth`).

**Login** saves the token to `{{token}}`, which every other request uses. To act as another role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the body) and send Login again.

**Registration**: admin accounts are created by a superadmin and start **inactive** (activate them in Approvals). Tenant accounts sign up publicly and are **active** right away.

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Logs in and saves the access token as `{{token}}` (valid for 1 hour), plus `{{currentUserId}}` and `{{currentRole}}`.

- superadmin: the seed account (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env`)
- admin / tenant: an account made with the Register requests (password `{{newUserPassword}}`; the email is saved as `{{registeredEmail}}`)

Errors: 401 wrong email/password, 403 `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` (account not activated yet).

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

Revokes the token used for this request (other sessions stay logged in) and clears `{{token}}`. Its open WebSocket connections receive `session:ended` (`logged_out`).

**Access:** superadmin

Creates an **admin** account. It starts inactive (`approval.isActive: false`) and cannot log in until activated with *Approvals → Activate / Deactivate User*. Every superadmin gets an `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION` notification.

Saves `{{userId}}`, `{{userRole}}` and `{{registeredEmail}}`. Optional: `faceImageId` (upload it first).

**Access:** public, no token

Public sign-up, no token needed. The tenant is **active right away**. `tenantName` is required. Every admin gets a `TENANT_REGISTERED` notification.

Saves `{{userId}}`, `{{userRole}}` and `{{registeredEmail}}`.

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

The logged-in account with its `faceImage` and account `approval`.

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

Updates your own account; send only the fields to change: `firstName`, `lastName`, `phoneNumber`, `email`, `faceImageId` (or `null`), `tenantName` (tenants only), `password` + `currentPassword`.

`id` and `role` can never be changed.

item.name: Images
item.description: Image upload (max 5 MB; jpg, png, webp, gif). Upload first, then use the returned id as `faceImageId`, product `imageId` or tenant `logoId`. Files are served publicly at `imgUrl`.

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

multipart/form-data, field **image** (pick a file in Body → form-data). Saves `{{imageId}}` and `{{imagePath}}` (`imgUrl`; the response also has the full link in `url`).

An image can be used once: as one product image, one tenant logo or one face image.

**Access:** public, no token

The public link of the uploaded image (`{{baseUrl}}` + `imgUrl`), as the frontend would load it.

**Access:** tenant

Deletes the image record and file. An image still used as a tenant logo cannot be deleted (409 `STILL_IN_USE`).

item.name: Users
item.description: Account lists. Tenants only have *Auth → Me*.

request.description:
**Access:** superadmin, admin

superadmin sees every account; admin sees tenant accounts only. Optional `role` filter. Each user includes `faceImage` and `approval`.

item.name: Approvals
item.description:
Activate / deactivate accounts and products: `PATCH /api/approvals/:id?type=user|product`. `:id` is the **user id** or **product id** (not the approval id).

| type | who can | what |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | superadmin → admin and tenant accounts; admin → tenant accounts | an inactive account cannot log in, and is disconnected from realtime right away |
| `product` | admin only | active products appear on the landing page |

Every approval has a `type` (`user` = account approval, `product` = product approval) and a `userId` (the account, or the tenant who owns the product).

request.description:
**Access:** superadmin, admin

`isActive`: true/false. `role`: the target account's role, as a confirmation (must match). `reason`: optional.

Uses `{{userId}}` / `{{userRole}}` saved by the Register requests. Deactivating ends the user's sessions (`session:ended`, reason `deactivated`).

**Access:** admin

Approves a product (shown on the landing page) or takes it down. The owner gets `PRODUCT_APPROVED`; admins get `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED`; deactivation notifies superadmins.

The response includes who owns it:
```json
{ "type": "product", "id": "…", "name": "…", "approval": { "type": "product", "userId": "…", "isActive": true, … },
  "user": { "firstName": "Budi", "lastName": "Santoso", …, "tenant": { … } | null, "productId": "…", "product": { … } } }
```

item.name: Products
item.description: Tenants manage their own products; superadmin/admin read all of them. New products start **inactive** and wait for an admin (*Approvals → Activate / Deactivate Product*).

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

superadmin/admin: every product. tenant: only their own. Optional `isActive` filter (e.g. `false` = waiting for approval).

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

Tenants get 404 for products that are not theirs.

**Access:** tenant

Upload the image first (*Images → Upload Image*); `imageId` is required. Saves `{{productId}}`. Superadmins and admins get `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED`, the tenant gets `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW`.

**Access:** tenant

Own products only. Send any of `name`, `description`, `details`, `qty`, `imageId`. Activation cannot be changed here.

**Access:** tenant

Own products only. Also deletes its approval and image.

**Access:** public, no token

Active (approved) products only, without private data (no owner email/phone, no approval reason).

item.description: Categories a tenant profile belongs to (e.g. Kuliner, Fashion). Managed by superadmin and admin.

request.description:
**Access:** superadmin, admin

Sorted by name.
**Access:** superadmin, admin

**Access:** superadmin, admin

Names are unique. Saves `{{categoryId}}`.
**Access:** superadmin, admin

**Access:** superadmin, admin

A category still used by a tenant profile cannot be deleted (409 `STILL_IN_USE`).

item.name: Tenants
item.description: Tenant (shop) profiles. A tenant user manages **their own** profile at `/api/tenants/me`; superadmin/admin read every profile.

request.description:
**Access:** tenant

404 if you have not created your profile yet.

**Access:** tenant

One profile per tenant. Required: every field except `name` (defaults to your tenantName). `logoId`: upload the logo first. `categoryId`: a tenant category (created by superadmin/admin). Saves `{{tenantProfileId}}`.

{
  "name": "Warung Budi",
  "description": "Kopi dan makanan ringan",
  "address": "Jl. Merdeka No. 1",
  "area": "Bandung",
  "operationalHours": "08:00 - 22:00",
  "fbLink": "https://facebook.com/warungbudi",
  "whatsappLink": "https://wa.me/6281298765432",
  "gmapsLink": "https://maps.app.goo.gl/example",
  "logoId": {{imageId}},
  "categoryId": {{categoryId}}
}

exec: ['imageId', 'categoryId'].forEach((k) => { if (!pm.environment.get(k)) throw new Error('{{' + k + '}} is empty: ' + (k === 'imageId' ? 'upload the logo first (Images → Upload Image)' : 'create a category first as superadmin/admin (Tenant Categories → Create)')); });

request.description:
**Access:** tenant

Send only the fields to change. Admins get `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED`.

**Access:** tenant

Deletes your tenant profile (your account stays).

**Access:** superadmin, admin

Every tenant profile with its owner, logo and category. Optional `categoryId` filter.

item.name: Notifications
item.description:
Notifications for every role (`/api/notifications`, Bearer `{{token}}`). They are created automatically by actions in the other folders.

| type | who gets it | when |
|---|---|---|
| `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION` | superadmin | a new admin is registered (needs activation) |
| `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED` | superadmin, admin | a tenant creates a product |
| `USER_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | an admin deactivates a user account |
| `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | an admin deactivates a product |
| `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED` | admin | an admin activates a product (now on the landing page) |
| `PRODUCT_UPDATED` | admin | a tenant updates a product |
| `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED` | admin | a tenant updates their tenant profile |
| `TENANT_REGISTERED` | admin | a new tenant signs up |
| `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW` | tenant (owner) | they create a product |
| `PRODUCT_APPROVED` | tenant (owner) | their product is activated |

Each notification: `id`, `type` (switch on it in the frontend), `name` (title), `description` (message), `entityType` + `entityId` (what to open: `user`, `product` or `tenant`), `approvalId` + `approval`, `isRead`, `readAt`, `createdAt`.

**Activation notifications** (`ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION`, `TENANT_REGISTERED`, `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED`, `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW`, `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED`, `PRODUCT_APPROVED`, `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED`, `USER_DEACTIVATED`) include the approval of the user/product they are about:
```json
"approval": { "id": 137, "type": "user", "userId": "<id>", "isActive": false, "reason": "Waiting for activation by a superadmin", "updatedAt": "...",
  "user": { "id": "<id>", "firstName": "Andi", "lastName": "Wijaya", "email": "...", "phoneNumber": "...", "role": "admin", "tenantName": null, ... } }
```
`approval.isActive` is the **current** status (not a copy from when it was sent), so the frontend can show an *Activate* button only while it is still `false`. To activate: `PATCH /api/approvals/{entityId}?type={entityType}` (body `{ "isActive": true, "role": "admin" }` for users, `{ "isActive": true }` for products). Other notifications (`PRODUCT_UPDATED`, `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED`) have `approvalId: null`, `approval: null`. If the product is deleted, `approval` becomes `null`. Every user only ever sees their own notifications (others → 404).

Endpoints: `GET /api/notifications?page=&limit=&unread=true` (newest first, `meta.unreadCount` for the badge), `GET /api/notifications/unread-count`, `PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read`, `PATCH /api/notifications/read-all`, `DELETE /api/notifications/:id`. `approval.user` is whose approval it is (the account owner, or the tenant who owns the product); it never contains the password.

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, admin, tenant)

Your own notifications, newest first. `meta.unreadCount` for the badge. Saves the newest one as `{{notificationId}}`.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.json().data.length) { pm.environment.set('notificationId', pm.response.json().data[0].id); console.log('saved {{notificationId}} = ' + pm.environment.get('notificationId')); }

item.name: Realtime (WebSocket)

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Engine.IO handshake: 200 with a session id means the realtime server is up. To receive events, create a Socket.IO request (see the folder description).

exec: pm.test('Handshake returns a session id', () => { var open = JSON.parse(pm.response.text().replace(/^0/, '')); pm.expect(open.sid).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(open.upgrades).to.include('websocket'); });
